name: ddostester
description: Load / resilience testing control plane for authorized infrastructure.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w backend && npm run test:coverage -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify:fast: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
